reason: I don't buy anything for my lips without reading reviews and seeing photos from women my age, and this has none. At $36 for a tinted balm from a brand I've never heard of, I'll wait and see what other people say.
objection: No reviews at all, and I only know it from an ad. A year-long guarantee sounds nice, but I don't know if a small new company will actually honor it or still be around to.
would_change_my_mind: A good number of real reviews with photos from women over 50 showing how the pink looks on older lips, ideally on Amazon or Trustpilot.
